findings.description: SFist's weekly food column named three addresses: Annunciation Greek Orthodox Cathedral at 245 Valencia Street as the venue of the Greek Food Festival on 18–20 September, a sushi counter at 1552 Fillmore Street, and Tacos El Patron, newly opened at 1325 Fillmore. The opening at 1325 Fillmore is a real occupancy change.

citation.label: SFist, “This Week In Food: More Fancy Takeout Sushi, Please,” 4 September 2026

publish.note: The entry is the headline and nothing else, and this headline — 'This Week In Food: More Fancy Takeout Sushi, Please' — says nothing about any of the three buildings. A round-up cannot produce a usable entry for one address inside it, and we may not write a substitute sentence. If Tacos El Patron's opening at 1325 Fillmore is covered on its own by any feed, that story carries it. The Greek festival is a venue mention and would be declined regardless.
